title: EUR/USD Targets 1.1471—Will the Fed’s SEP Validate Four-Hike Pricing?
summary: One Fed hike is effectively certain today, but markets are pricing four hikes total at an approximately quarterly cadence—whether the SEP validates that path, or its hawkish tail, will decide whether EUR/USD extends below 1.1471 or reverses back through 1.1653. title: Gold gains some positive traction as USD bulls turn cautious ahead of Fed rate decision
summary: Gold (XAU/USD) attracts some dip-buyers near the $4,275 region during the Asian session on Wednesday, though the upside potential seems limited. The US Dollar (USD) pauses for a breather after touching a two-week high and offers some support to the commodity.
